title: Grimm - the Adventures Of Chanticleer And Partlet

evidence.paraphrase: The landlord exclaims in frustration after being pricked and having eggshells fly into his eyes.
evidence.quote:
Bless me!" said
      he, "all the world seems to have a design against my head this morning"

evidence.paraphrase: Mr Korbes the fox is killed when a millstone falls on his head.
evidence.quote:
when he came to the door, the millstone fell down on his
      head, and killed him on the spot

evidence.paraphrase: Partlet dies, choked by the large nut, before water can be brought.
evidence.quote:
in the meantime she
      was choked by the great nut, and lay quite dead, and never moved any more

evidence.paraphrase: The six mice drown when the straw bridge slips into the stream.
evidence.quote:
the six mice all fell in and were
      drowned

evidence.paraphrase: The fox and other animal mourners fall into the stream and drown.
evidence.quote:
the fox and the other mourners, who were sitting behind, were
      too heavy, and fell back into the water and were all carried away by the
      stream and drowned

evidence.paraphrase: Chanticleer and the beasts grieve over Partlet's death.
evidence.quote:
Then Chanticleer was very sorry, and cried bitterly; and all the beasts
      came and wept with him over poor Partlet
